Subject: Map Kickoff: Aurora Health — initial MAP draft & timeline options

Hi Sofia / Michael — thanks again for the time today. Great discovery call; appreciate the clarity on the billing flows and where low-latency inference is most critical. Per our conversation, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and a short summary of the milestones we discussed.

Quick summary of next steps I captured: 
- You: confirm internal stakeholders and procurement timeline (target close window).
- Us: share MAP draft, updated pricing band for dedicated capacity, and SOC-2 artifacts.
- Joint: schedule MAP kickoff session (30–45m) to align on responsibilities and target close date.

Attached: Aurora_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones, owners, tentative dates) and discovery-notes.pdf.

Options for MAP kickoff (pick one that works for you):
1) Wed Oct 14, 9:00–9:45am PT — short intro + scope owners
2) Thu Oct 15, 11:00–11:45am PT — deeper ops/infra discussion
3) Mon Oct 19, 2:00–3:00pm PT — flexible, open slot for additional stakeholders

Proposed target close date (per your ACV/priority): Dec 10, 2026 (we can move earlier if procurement runs faster).

Please confirm: A) which kickoff slot works, B) confirmed stakeholders (procurement, security/compliance, infra), and C) any dependencies we should add to the MAP (e.g., Proof of Concept infra, SOC-2 evidence).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers: 

A) Kickoff: Thu Oct 15, 11:00–11:45am PT works for us.
B) Stakeholders to include on the kickoff: 
   - Sofia Ramirez (VP Product) — decision owner
   - Michael Dunn (Head of Data & Analytics) — technical owner
   - Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@aurorahealth.com> (Security) — security reviewer
   - Procurement mailbox (procurement@aurorahealth.com) — for contracting timeline
C) Dependencies: 
   - Need SOC2 type II summary and architecture diagram for security review (can you surface these?)
   - We will require a short POC (2-week sandbox) to validate latency on our sample traffic; put that as a Milestone in the MAP.

We are aiming for the end-of-Q4 procurement target but procurement has a few scheduled freezes in late Nov; tentative target close Dec 10 is fine but we may need to accelerate the POC in Oct to keep pace.

Forwarding to procurement for visibility.

Thanks,
Michael
Head of Data & Analytics
